Title: PCIe_S92 | addlink
URL: https://www.addlink.com.tw/pcie-s92
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
# addlink S92 SSD is built with next-generation QLC 3D NAND while using the latest Gen4 PCIe technology to achieve blazing fast sequential read speeds up to 4900 MB/s, which is perfect for heavy-duty applications, such as digital audio/video production, gaming and professional use, that has no room for system lags or any kinds of slowdowns.

# Extreme speed with 3D NAND

As a PCIe 4.0 SSD, the S92 delivers incredible storage performance, delivering up to 10 times the sequential read and sequential write speeds of some SATA SSDs and up to 50 times the speed of some traditional HDDs. The S92 is also fully backwards compatible with current PCIe 3.0 platforms.

...

Smaller Footprint

QLC technology's ability to increase per-server density reduces rack space by up to 7.7X compared to 2TB HDDs, saving precious and expensive data center real estate.

# Superior Endurance for Heavy-Duty Applications

Experience the unprecedented performance for heavy workloads and engineering applications with the highly reliable S92 SSD, available in high capacity up to 4TB. The S92 boasts a cutting-edge 3D NAND-based architecture that delivers the next-generation performance in a compact M.2 form factor.

Title: Addlink: Up to 4TB PCIe Gen4x4 S92 SSD With Phison Controller and QLC NAND - StorageNewsletter
URL: https://www.storagenewsletter.com/2020/10/12/addlink-up-to-4tb-pcie-gen4x4-s92-ssd-with-phison-controller-and-qlc-nand/
Published: 2020-10-12T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Addlink Technology introduces 1/2/4TB PCIe Gen4x4 QLC SSD that can reach speeds of 4.9GB/s for sequential reads and 3.8GB/s for sequential writes.

The S92 SSD, a high-end NVMe PCIE Gen4x4 SSD, is for any heavy workloads task. Its target to professional designer, photographer, youtuber, or heavy game player.

The S92 is with M.2 NVMe SSD Gen4x4 that can deliver at speed of up to 4.9GB/s for sequential reads and 3.6GB/s for sequential writes and hit upwards of random R/W speed of up to 350,000/700,000 IO/s. It is ready for AMD RYZEN 3 rd gen and compatible with most motherboards from major brands.

With 3D QLC NAND storage technology, the S92 PCIe Gen 4×4 incorporates a high memory cell density, allowing for storage capacity on a smaller footprint – up to 4TB. And balance the performance and cost.

It brings to the customer better performance, higher density, and endurance. It comes with Phison Electronics Corp.‘ premium controller- PS5016-E16 to utilize QLC NAND flash and enable SSD capacity. It brings to the customer better performance, higher density, and reliable endurance. 

It supports ECC technology, Wear Leveling, Bad Block Management, and over-Provision features to guarantee the QLC SSD Reliability. The device also supports secure erase, TRIM and SMART commands to help customer can optimized and monitor their S92 SSD device.

The Addlink S92 NVMe PCIe M.2 SSD come with warranty of 5 years and is available in three capacities: 1TB, 2TB and 4TB on Amazon.

This SSD has a maximum sequential read-write speed of up to 4900/3600 MB per second, making it ideal for gaming and workstation PCs.

Addlink S92 is equiped with DRAM memory, and a QLC NAND flash memory with 96 cell layers.

### NAND type

Addlink S92 is using a QLC (4 bits per cell) NAND manufacurted by Kioxia with 96 cell layers on top of each other.

QLC is slow and less durable compared to TLC and SLC. The TLC is the most common type of SSD NAND flash memory found on the market at the moment. It is faster, less durable, but still cheaper than the other, more expensive variants - SLC and MLC.

### The Controller

Addlink S92 is using Phison E16 SSD controller to connect the NAND memory to the x4 PCIe 4.0/NVMe interface. The controller has Dual R5 + CoX, 8-ch, 4-CE/ch configuration.
